data.title: 安洁莉娜 · 礼物上的丝带
data.description: 她试着系出整齐的蝴蝶结，第二次终于成功，便把写好的小卡片塞进丝带下。
data.camera: 中近景，礼物盒与丝带清晰
data.promptProse: Sitting at an oak desk under the warm pool of a reading lamp, Angelina deftly ties a clean satin bow onto a neatly wrapped kraft gift box. Spools of colorful ribbon, craft scissors, and a hand-lettered greeting card lie arranged across the workspace.
data.animaCaption: Pulling the ribbon loops into a crisp, symmetrical bow, she tucks a handwritten note beneath the satin knot with proud satisfaction.
